title: heteroTests: Heteroscedasticity Diagnostics for Linear Models in R
description: heteroTests is an R package for heteroscedasticity diagnostics in linear-model workflows. It provides a consistent interface for classical variance diagnostics including White, Breusch-Pagan, Koenker, Goldfeld-Quandt, group-wise variance tests and ARCH-related checks, together with streaming implementations, simulation utilities, diagnostic visualisation and workflow helpers. The project emphasizes reproducible statistical software, reference comparisons, behavioural testing and explicit assumptions; advanced and experimental diagnostics remain subject to ongoing validation.
